market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has historically suffered >90% drawdowns during crypto bear markets (e.g., $260→$8 in 2022). The market-implied 9.5% for a dip to $20 by end-2026 appears to underestimate tail risk, especially if we are near a post-halving cycle peak. A repeat of a severe downturn would easily breach $20, making a true probability closer to 15% plausible.
evidence_points: SOL fell from ~$260 to ~$8 in the 2022 bear market, a 97% decline, showing $20 is well within historic crash ranges.
Crypto market cycles following Bitcoin halvings (2024 halving) often peak 12-18 months later, putting late 2025/2026 at risk of a major correction.
The 13-month window from Nov 2025 to Dec 2026 is long enough to include both a blow-off top and a capitulation event, increasing the chance of touching $20.
sources_consulted: Solana price performance over previous cycles
